Title: Microsoft plans to establish new cloud datacenter region in Austria

Body.Content:
On October 20, 2020, Microsoft announced intent to build a new datacenter region in Austria. The announcement also included details around establishment of a new Center of Digital Excellence in Austria, as well as a digital skilling initiative targeted at reaching approximately 120,000 Austrians by 2024.

Learn more.
